# Finance Manager Skill for Muse

A complete personal-finance system: it extracts transactions from PDF bank statements into CSV, analyzes them — savings rate, top spending, category breakdown, personalized budget recommendations — then generates an interactive HTML report with charts (donut by category, income-vs-expenses bars). Built-in benchmarks keep you honest: savings rate tiers (under 10% needs work, 20–30% excellent), per-category budgets (housing 25–30%…), and the 50/30/20 rule detailed in the references. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: pip dependencies (pdfplumber, pandas); always double-check extracted PDF data; ignore the repo's sample transactions.csv. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
